items.question: Which sacred place-name is paired with the washerwoman in the Uddiyana statement?
premises: Uddiyana is addressed to the great goddess.
items.inference: The verse pairs Uddiyana with the washerwoman and Pauṇḍravardhana.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation among the three nouns is not explicit.
items.plain_english: Uddiyana, O great goddess, [is] the washerwoman Pauṇḍravardhana.
